name: Jormungand
source: Black kitten that reside in [url=/c61580]Hela's[/url] mansion. Originally one of the evil spirits, but she couldn't find a body during the resurrection, but it is possible to transform into a human body by fusing herself with a body of dead warrior, Gelhilde.
